text_block_list.text:
One day, after fighting through
many races alongside Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's go to the hot springs! ☆
choice_data_list: Hot springs... Ah, from the raffle—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer, looks like now's not the time for the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even if you go now, all that awaits you is a jewel caked in dirt. An unmistakable jewel, yes, but an unpolished, unsparkling gem.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Once you're ready to polish it into a marvelous gem,
let's go together☆

...Back then, she said the time had not yet come.
Since she came to invite me, does this mean now is the right moment?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry! Go-go to the hot springs☆★☆

—Carried along by an irresistible momentum,
the hot spring trip began the very next day.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Waaahhhhh...! This gate looks just like it used to!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how the room and the bath are!?
My heart is totally thumping with excitement☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I know! Before we hop into the hot springs, let's explore the area!
I bet we'll find tons of marvelous thingsâ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay yaaay!
It's a thrilling, marvelous experience spotâ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Trainer can cross over~?

It looks unstable, but it seems to be a suspension bridge in regular use.
If so, there should be no danger.
As long as I know that, it's not scary.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, MAAARVELOUS☆
For a Trainer like that,
I'll deliver even more marvelousness★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"It says, 'Do not cross this suspension bridge
with more than one person at a time'!"

“—We crossed the suspension bridge and completed the loop along the mountain stream trail.
Afterwards, we headed into the hot spring town, hopping between souvenir shops.
Having enjoyed our walk to the fullest, we returned to the inn.”
In the bath...
After getting out of the bath and relaxing in the room—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
There's a festival going on nearby! Let's go together☆
choice_data_list: Full of energy as always, I see.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I want to play to my heart's content today!
I want to turn it all into Marvelous memories☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Will you collect marvelous memories with me?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, over here, over here!
They're handing out spring-water kuzumochi at the shrine in the back☆
It's super jiggly and simply marvelous★☆

"...To tell the truth, it has been on my mind
ever since we arrived at the hot springs. Could it be—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Long ago~,
I used to stay at a hot spring spa for recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was always getting sick.
Grandma said the air and hot springs here are so nice
that it'd help make me feel a bit better.

Marvelous Sunday said it nonchalantly.
However, I've heard that when she was young, she was frail
and had even hovered between life and death...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...The suspension bridge, the mountain stream, and this festival we went to today.
I came here with my grandma a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I could only see a tiny bit of it.
Just walking a little made it hard to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Back before I discovered the Marvelous,
everything I saw was just shades of gray.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —The memories sleeping here had grown dull.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But with who I am now,
able to deliver top-tier marvelous to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: As long as you're by my side, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I thought I could turn even dull, faded memories into sparkling, marvelous ones☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So you see, Trainer!
There are still sooooo many places I want to go!
choice_data_list: —I'm with you all the way. No matter how far.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe!
I knew you'd say that ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first let's eat some kuzumochi☆
After that, yo-yo fishing, then the shooting gallery!
And then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ahahahaha!
MAAARVELOOOUUUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Trainer, listen, listen!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I realized it!
All the marvelous wonders that were lying dormant☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Being happy that I can do things I couldn't do before!
And how wonderful the wind feels when I run!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because I know the pain of those days! Because I felt eternity in the repeating sound of the waves!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That is super marrrvelous☆★☆

It seemed Marvelous Sunday was able to turn
her dull memories into marvelous ones.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Besides, it made me remember. The warmth of Grandma's hand holding mine as we stood side by side, looking out at the sea.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It was so, so marvelous.
Yet it feels like I had completely forgotten until today.
choice_data_list: ...I'm glad you have some time to relax.
...I'm glad you have time to relax.

text_block_list.text: Without thinking, I murmured those words.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks to you, Trainer, I remembered!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Spending time with you today made my heart feel all warm and fuzzy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "And that reminded me of how warm and cozy it felt whenever I was with Grandma☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmmm, maybe it's a slightly different kind of
Marvelous from when I'm with Grandma...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Not toasty warm, but... crinkly-crunchy, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that sounds fun☆

It was a moment where I felt an
irreplaceable bond with Marvelous Sunday...
